relationships.subject: Nav1.8+ nociceptors
relationships.evidence_quote: Taken together, our results reveal that nociceptor-derived CGRP promotes cDC1-CD8<sup>+</sup> T cell interactions

relationships.subject: rimegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: or treatment with a CGRP receptor antagonist (rimegepant) abrogated CD8<sup>+</sup> T cell autoreactivity and prevented skin depigmentation in a mouse model of vitiligo

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Conversely, CGRP administration restored vitiligo development in nociceptor-ablated mice.

key_findings: Nociceptor-derived CGRP acts on cDC1 CGRP receptor to drive autoreactive CD8+ T cells in vitiligo.
Ablation of Nav1.8+ nociceptors, cDC1 CGRPR deletion or rimegepant prevented depigmentation; topical rimegepant helped in a pilot study.
